LogoCreator

## README

# Logo Creator - AI-Powered Mobile Logo Generator

Generate professional logos using OpenAI's APIs with a beautiful React Native interface.

## Features

- 🎨 **Dual Generation Modes**
  - **SVG Mode**: GPT-4 generates pure vector logos (editable, scalable)
  - **PNG Mode**: DALL-E 3 creates raster logos (photorealistic options)

- 🚀 **Smart Brief System**
  - Brand name, concept, mood inputs
  - Style presets (minimal, geometric, abstract, modern)
  - Custom color palettes with visual picker

- 📱 **Native Export**
  - Save to device gallery
  - Share directly via native share sheet
  - Multiple format support (SVG, PNG)

- 🔄 **Batch Generation**
  - Creates 3 variations per request
  - Easy comparison with thumbnail grid
  - Individual regeneration (coming soon)

## Setup

### 1. Install Dependencies

\`\`\`bash
npm install
\`\`\`

### 2. Configure Environment

Create a `.env` file in the root directory:

\`\`\`bash
cp .env.example .env
\`\`\`

Edit `.env` and add your OpenAI API key:

\`\`\`
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-your-key-here
OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL=dall-e-3
OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL=gpt-4
\`\`\`

### 3. Run the App

\`\`\`bash
# iOS
npm run ios

# Android  
npm run android

# Web (development)
npm run web
\`\`\`

## Project Structure

\`\`\`
LogoCreator/
├── app/
│   ├── index.tsx          # Main app screen
│   └── _layout.tsx        # Navigation layout
├── components/
│   ├── BriefForm.tsx      # Logo brief input form
│   └── LogoPreview.tsx    # Preview & export screen
├── services/
│   ├── openai.service.ts  # OpenAI API integration
│   └── imageTracer.service.ts  # PNG→SVG conversion (placeholder)
├── config/
│   └── env.ts             # Environment config
├── .env.example           # Example environment file
└── README.md
\`\`\`

## How It Works

### SVG Generation (Recommended)

1. **Brief Form** → User fills out brand details, colors, style
2. **GPT-4 Prompt** → System prompt enforces strict SVG constraints:
   - 512×512 viewBox
   - Max 8 path elements
   - Solid fills only
   - No external dependencies
3. **SVG Output** → Model returns pure \`<svg>\` markup
4. **Preview** → Rendered with \`react-native-svg\`
5. **Export** → Saved as scalable vector file

### PNG Generation

1. **Brief Form** → Same inputs
2. **DALL-E 3 Prompt** → Optimized for flat, logo-style imagery
3. **PNG Output** → 1024×1024 high-quality raster
4. **Preview** → Rendered as base64 image
5. **Export** → Saved to device gallery

## Key Technologies

- **Expo** - React Native framework
- **react-native-svg** - SVG rendering
- **OpenAI SDK** - GPT-4 & DALL-E 3 APIs
- **expo-file-system** - File operations
- **expo-sharing** - Native share functionality
- **expo-media-library** - Gallery saves

## References & Inspirations

### Open-Source Logo Generators
- [Nutlope/logocreator](https://github.com/Nutlope/logocreator) - Next.js AI logo generator (web)
- [LogoAI](https://github.com/Arindam200/logo-ai) - Next.js starter
- [Next-Logo-Generator](https://github.com/hagaitrg/Next-Logo-Generator) - SVG + PNG generator

### PNG→SVG Vectorization (Future Enhancement)
- [ImageTracer.js](https://github.com/jankovicsandras/imagetracerjs) - JavaScript bitmap→SVG
- [swift-potrace](https://github.com/sfomuseum/swift-potrace) - iOS potrace package
- [antrace](https://github.com/jiangpeng79/antrace) - Android potrace port
- [Potrace](https://potrace.sourceforge.net/) - Original algorithm

### Mobile SVG Rendering
- [react-native-svg](https://github.com/software-mansion/react-native-svg) - React Native
- [flutter_svg](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_svg) - Flutter (alternative)

### Icon Tooling
- [SnapAI](https://github.com/betomoedano/snapai) - OpenAI icon CLI
- [Nova Icon CLI](https://github.com/sleez007/App-Icon-generator) - DALL·E icon generator
- [Icon Set Creator](https://github.com/martiliones/icon-set-creator) - iOS/Android asset generator
